before: Differentiation is slow, and it goes on your whole life. If your family or group won't let you do this while you're still part of it, temporary distance may be necessary. Some people come back later on different terms. Sometimes the leaving is permanent, because going back would mean disappearing again, and you aren't punishing anyone by staying away. You don't have to know yet which one yours is. As you differentiate, you learn to tell the difference, maybe on the way home from a visit, when you notice how long it's taking to feel like yourself again.
